question: Who is the true agent behind ritual acts and ordinary bodily activities?
premises: Caṇḍikā performs offering, recitation, worship, laughter, and movement.
She is present in eating and sexual union.
Dwelling in the body, she is the doer of actions.
inference: The same goddess immanent in the body is the real agent of both ritual and ordinary actions.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of vihaset in this ritual context is somewhat open.
plain_english: She offers into the fire, recites, worships, laughs, and moves; in eating and in sexual union, that same goddess, dwelling in the body, is the doer of all actions.
